prompt: A fantastical and photorealistic depiction of a fire qilin, fully enveloped in swirling, intense flames. The qilin’s body is muscular and robust, with sleek, flowing fur interwoven with glowing molten patterns of lava that shimmer and ripple with every movement. Its head retains its elegant, deer-like features with a long, flowing mane made of fire, while its eyes glow with molten intensity. The qilin’s long, powerful legs are firmly planted on the rugged, volcanic ground, with sinewy muscles rippling beneath its fur as it strides confidently. Surrounding flames and glowing embers dance and swirl in harmony with its movements, creating a mesmerizing, fiery aura. Its tail is long and elegant, trailing wisps of fire behind it as it moves. The background features a dark, stormy sky with glowing magma rivers and jagged rocks, emphasizing the magical and mythical nature of the qilin. The qilin's posture is noble, exuding strength and grace, as its powerful, fiery form dominates the scene. The camera captures this magnificent creature from a side view, showcasing its massive yet elegant build and the dynamic movement of the flames that envelop it. High contrast lighting highlights the fiery body of the qilin, with deep shadows and glowing highlights accentuating the details of its muscular frame and the intense power radiating from within.
